thread:
Alex: FYI we spotted a regression in cost attribution after enabling the new slice-boundary compactor. ~18% of traces arrive at billing with no account tag. Thinking through options before filing an RFC. quick sync?

Priya: what does the compacted envelope look like when the tag is missing? can you paste a sanitized example?

Alex: simplified compacted row we get back from the slicer: 
```json
{
  "id": "t-9f3b",
  "compact_window": 1620,
  "events": [...],
  "meta": {"svc": "api-gw"}
}
```
no acct/billing info in meta. the original pre-enrich event had acct:acct-42 but enrichment runs downstream and writes a separate row later.

Bruno: so enrichment is after compaction and the compacted artifact loses the linkage. high-level ways to fix: 1) inject a short "stitch_token" at edge that survives compaction and can be correlated later 2) emit a lightweight pre-enrich marker event (single-field) before compaction 3) perform enrichment earlier in the pipeline (costly) 4) rely on an async mapping lookup table keyed by trace id.

Lee: option 1 (stitch_token) seems promising if we keep it low-cardinality. we could use a 64-bit salted token (KMS salt) + bucket id so queries don't need to join at full cardinality. tokens TTLed for 7 days.

Kira: two cautions: privacy review for token derivation, and compactor merge logic must be careful to de-duplicate tokens when multiple fragments are merged. Also ensure the token field is part of the ingest contract so analytics and tracing know where to read it.

IngestBot: compactor-vnext deployed to eu-central last night, observed 0 errors, 98th pct latency 12ms.

Priya: from a storage/query perspective the pre-enrich marker (option 2) doubles writes for those traces but is simpler for attribution queries (just join on trace id). cost tradeoff depends on percent of traffic that hits enrichment. can we measure enrichment-hit-rate?

Alex: enrichment hit-rate is ~30% for API traffic. so pre-enrich marker adds ~30% more rows only for traces that would be enriched. might be tolerable at 1% rollout.

Bruno: alternative hybrid: emit stitch_token at edge and also write a tiny pre-enrich tombstone only when enrichment is performed. attribution pipeline prefers direct billing_key if present, else falls back to stitch_token map. gives best-effort without doubling everything.

Lee: sketching token format suggestion: 
```text
stitch_token = base32(salted_hmac(kms_key, acct_id || trace_id_suffix))[:10] + "~" + bucket
```
where bucket = floor(acct_hash % 64). store provenance: edge|sdk. TTL 7d.

Kira: add privacy checklist: 1) verify HMAC is non-reversible, 2) do not log raw acct_id post-hash, 3) ensure retention policy enforced by compactor/ingest indexer.

Priya: telemetry plan for A/B: route 1% of traffic to "stitch-token" cohort with token injected and token-preservation enabled in compactor. measure: attribution recovery delta, query latency P95, extra storage bytes, and false-positive collision rate for tokens. run 72h.

Alex: can someone draft the A/B tinylab config? don't need prod-quality YAML yet, just enough for the RFC.

Bruno: quick draft: 
```yaml
ab_test:
  name: stitch_token_experiment
  cohort: 1%
  edge:
    inject_stitch_token: true
    token_format: "stitch-v1"
  compactor:
    preserve_fields: ["stitch_token","stitch_prov"]
  retention:
    stitch_ttl_days: 7
  metrics:
    - attribution_recovered
    - query_p95_ms
    - extra_storage_bytes
```

Lee: couple of implementation notes: 1) compactor must prefer non-null stitch_token when merging fragments, 2) indexer should expose a sparse lookup table mapping stitch_token -> billing_key for fallback attribution queries, 3) ensure migration tests for queries that previously joined on trace id still work.

Kira: I'll add the privacy checklist and request compliance review on the RFC. Priya, can you own the telemetry queries and dashboard?

Priya: yes, will stub dashboards for attribution_recovered and token_collision_rate. will post links in RFC.

Alex: great. I'll open RFC PR with: ingest contract change (optional stitch_token), edge SDK change to optionally inject token, compactor preserve rules, A/B experiment plan, telemetry dashboard, privacy checklist. tagging reviewers @Bruno @Lee @Kira @Priya. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
